description: Hours baseline (Arithmetic in the Wild, arXiv:2605.01148): no-intervention accuracy on all 1,152 hours prompts (24 concepts x 48 spelled-out offsets, the paper template with a trailing space so the zero-padded hour is the single next token). Golden: paper reports 70.8%; band [0.65, 0.75] from the VeriFires arithmetic-in-the-wild-hours checklist.
